entities.summary: Frans Hjalmar Nortamo was a writer and a medical doctor who is usually associated with Rauma, Finland, although he also lived in other, neighboring towns and municipalities. Frans Hjalmar Nortamo was a physicians & medical pioneers from Rauma (1860-06-13, Rauma–1931-11-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
